items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and then Solomon De ? How do you pronounce that? Do you remember that? [INTERVIEWEE] Who?

ctx.x: I don’t remember, Anthony. I just – I remember I did the date, but I just don’t recall. I know I did some solos in there. There were little spots for me to play solos here and there. Esther Phillips also is from my home town. They used to call her Little Esther.
Right, right. I know, because of Johnny Otis. They have a lot of Mongo, and then Solomon De ? How do you pronounce that? Do you remember that?
